Final DDR part, DDR3 versus DDR3L, VTT/VREF tolerance and source/sink currents
EPE/Power Analyzer with HPS, DDR, final clocks, activity, junction temperature and process corner
Actual USB accessories and microSD write/inrush peaks; allowance is one 500mA USB load
Regulator efficiency, current limits, soft start, capacitors, compensation and thermal derating
Protection cutoff thresholds, surge withstand, reverse blocking, discharge and cable loss
Program and read back STUSB4500 NVM; verify 9V/3A matching, mismatch, hard reset and default-policy exclusion
Physical status adapter and alert/read-clear race handling; no actual I2C interface implemented
Hold-up time and persistent fault logging on total power loss
Latest USB Type-C/PD compliance revision and test plan closure
Physical DE1-SoC, production circuit, ADC telemetry and hardware measurements unavailable
